title: The database refuses two live bookings whose times overlap, not only two that start at the same instant

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: the race guard is a unique index on (space_id, starts_at) where status in (confirmed, pending). Overlap with different starts is checked only in application code after a read, so two bookers racing (a 60 minute service at 10:00 and a 30 minute one at 10:30, or any buffered pair) both pass and both insert. Fix: btree_gist plus an exclusion constraint on (space_id with =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) with &&) for live statuses, with the insert error mapped to the existing 'just taken' message. Buffers stay an app rule.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
